title: Going to the Dentist
description: Three short recordings about the dentist: a worried boy, a phone call and some advice for children.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Ben and Mum
parts.intro: You will hear Ben talking to his mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Come on, Ben. We're going to be late for the dentist.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Do I have to go, Mum? I don't like it.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Don't worry. Dr Rose is very kind. She just looks at your teeth.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: What if she finds a hole?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: You always clean your teeth in the morning and at night, so I'm sure they're fine.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Well, I do forget at night sometimes. But I never eat sweets on weekdays.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: That's good. After the dentist, we can go to the park.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Can you stay with me in the room, Mum?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Of course I can. I'll sit next to you and hold your hand all the time.

parts.title: Part 2 · A phone call
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Smith calling the dentist.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: Good morning, Happy Smiles Dentist.

script.speaker: Mr Smith
script.text: Hello. I'd like an appointment for my daughter, please. Her name's Amy.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: How about Tuesday at four o'clock?

script.speaker: Mr Smith
script.text: Sorry, she has swimming on Tuesday. Is Wednesday possible?

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: Yes. Wednesday at half past three is free.

script.speaker: Mr Smith
script.text: Perfect. She's nine years old. Do I need to bring anything?

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: Please bring her yellow health card. And you can park behind the building.

script.speaker: Mr Smith
script.text: Thank you very much. We'll see you on Wednesday.

script.speaker: Mrs Hill
script.text: You're welcome. Goodbye, Mr Smith, and have a nice day.

parts.title: Part 3 · Healthy teeth
parts.intro: You will hear a dentist talking to a class of children.

script.speaker: Dr Rose
script.text: Hello, children. I'm Dr Rose, and today I'll tell you how to keep your teeth healthy.

script.speaker: Dr Rose
script.text: First, clean your teeth for two minutes, twice a day. Use a soft brush and a little toothpaste.

script.speaker: Dr Rose
script.text: Second, drink water instead of fizzy drinks.

script.speaker: Dr Rose
script.text: Third, eat apples and carrots, because they are good for your teeth.

script.speaker: Dr Rose
script.text: Sweets are fine on Saturdays, but not every day.

script.speaker: Dr Rose
script.text: And remember, visit me every six months. Smile!
